The [[Imperial Dragon Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing Dmg]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
: Damage +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)
: [[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
